verdict.rationale: A community hands-on comment praises Stagehand/Browserbase's 'built in proxies and captcha' handling for adversarial sites, and docs confirm Browserbase supports multi-region session placement (geo-targeting) — but there is no first-party documentation of stealth fingerprinting configuration or explicit residential-proxy selection controls. missing for 10: dedicated docs on fingerprint spoofing/stealth mode, explicit residential proxy configuration options, and independent verification that bot-block evasion works reliably.
